verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents a Files API for creating, reading, editing, moving and deleting files and folders. It ships official API v2 SDKs, with GitHub code showing folder listing (filesListFolder) and developer guidance on uploading file data. Together these cover programmatic upload, list, move and delete beyond the desktop client. Missing for 10: an explicit raw REST/HTTP endpoint reference in the evidence (the probes found no OpenAPI spec or markdown HTTP docs), explicit download-endpoint evidence beyond 'reading', and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, files move through a real API — upload, download, list, move, and delete over documented REST endpoints, not just a desktop client
